description: The CT Cranium DICOM dataset is loaded in InVesalius 3. Generate a 3D surface of the skull (bone mask), then create a rotating animation of the skull model. You can either (A) export a series of PNG screenshots (at least 12 frames) covering at least 180 degrees of rotation to the folder '/home/ga/Documents/skull_rotation_frames/', or (B) export a single video file to '/home/ga/Documents/skull_rotation.avi'. Ensure the output captures the rotation clearly.
